description: Manually reviewed test set for the sample handbook. Evidence is given as verbatim quotes and located in the document when the set is loaded.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
questions.reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
evidence_quotes: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
questions.reference_answer: New employees complete a probation period of 90 days.
evidence_quotes: New employees complete a probation period of 90 days.

questions.question: Who has to approve international business travel?
questions.reference_answer: International travel must be approved by a department director before any booking is made.
evidence_quotes: International travel must be approved by a department director before any booking is made.

questions.question: What is the nightly limit for a hotel within the country?
questions.reference_answer: Hotel stays within the country are reimbursed up to 150 euros per night.
evidence_quotes: Hotel stays within the country are reimbursed up to 150 euros per night.

questions.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave do primary caregivers receive?
questions.reference_answer: Primary caregivers are offered 18 weeks of fully paid parental leave.
evidence_quotes: Primary caregivers are offered 18 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

questions.question: Which app is used to submit expense claims?
questions.reference_answer: Expense claims are submitted through the Ledgerly app with a photo of each receipt.
evidence_quotes: Expense claims are submitted through the Ledgerly app with a photo of each receipt.

questions.question: What should I do if my company laptop is stolen?
questions.reference_answer: Report it to the IT Service Desk within 24 hours so it can be locked remotely; a police report is required for stolen devices.
evidence_quotes: If a company laptop is lost or stolen, the employee must report it to the IT Service Desk within 24 hours so the device can be locked remotely.
A police report is required for stolen devices.

questions.question: What hardware budget does a new engineer get, and how often does it renew?
questions.reference_answer: New engineers receive a 2,500 euro hardware budget, which renews every three years.
evidence_quotes: Every new engineer receives a hardware budget of 2,500 euros for a laptop, monitor and accessories.
The hardware budget renews every three years, and older equipment may be kept after the renewal.

questions.question: How long can I work from another country, and who must approve a longer stay abroad?
questions.reference_answer: Working from another country is limited to 30 working days per year; stays longer than 10 consecutive working days need approval from the manager and People Operations.
evidence_quotes: Working from another country is limited to a maximum of 30 working days per calendar year.
Any stay abroad longer than 10 consecutive working days must be approved in advance by the employee's manager and the People Operations team.
